title: grid man-memory 4x25: 4 igniters walking at once

regions.name: router / broadcaster
regions.note: one op in, three words out to every column at once. The strip spans the whole width so each column's pipe is a two-cell stub off its south wall, and it owns no other outgoing pipe — `S` would broadcast into that too.

regions.name: collector strip
regions.note: `R` takes from any incoming pipe, so answers need no addressing. It is on the *bottom* on purpose: answer pipes never cross broadcast pipes, and every column's answer travels the same distance, so a later op's answer cannot overtake an earlier one.

regions.name: column 0: addr 0-24
regions.note: its own igniter, its own `@`, walking at tick 0 like every other column's. It is handed 0 as a literal and counts up, so these decoders hold global addresses and the head above them decodes nothing.

regions.name: repeater 0
regions.note: `r S` three times: take a word off the strip, shout it at this column
